overridableConfigKeys.label: Curve Mods Enabled
overridableConfigKeys.description: When true, entity.curveMods reshape the skate surface inside each mod's x-range: the road samples the base curve at b·(x − h) and applies a·y + k (slope scales by a·b) — coefficient pads lift/tilt/compress the segment the player is riding. Multiple overlapping mods stack by summing each mod's delta from the base surface; a mod whose shifted sample leaves the curve range is skipped. Default off: boards without coef pads pay nothing.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Drift Regions
overridableConfigKeys.description: Axis-aligned rects (x0..x1, y0..y1 in world units) each carrying a constant acceleration (ax, ay in units/s²) applied with the physics dt whenever the body's center is inside — winds, currents, gradient pushes. Empty list = zero behavior change. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.driftRegions — SET_DRIFT_REGIONS replaces it at runtime and RESTART does not reseed it.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Gravity
overridableConfigKeys.description: Units/s² added to vertical velocity; the SIGN is the vertical convention — positive pulls toward +y (screen boards, y down), negative toward −y (math canvases, y up) — and jumps always fire against it

overridableConfigKeys.label: Jump Strength
overridableConfigKeys.description: Vertical speed in units/s imparted by JUMP, directed against gravity; apex height ≈ jumpStrength² / (2·|gravity|)

overridableConfigKeys.label: Kill Y
overridableConfigKeys.description: Fall line: crossing it in the gravity direction fires BODY_FELL once (past it downward on y-down boards, below it on y-up canvases); y-up consumers must set a value below their world floor

overridableConfigKeys.label: Max Fall Speed
overridableConfigKeys.description: Terminal velocity cap in units/s applied to vertical speed each tick

overridableConfigKeys.label: Move Speed
overridableConfigKeys.description: Horizontal run speed in units/s applied by STEER dir ±1

overridableConfigKeys.label: Platforms
overridableConfigKeys.description: Level geometry as min-corner rects: ground/platform tiles are solid one-way landing surfaces, hazard tiles emit BODY_HAZARD on touch, goal tiles emit BODY_GOAL. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.platforms — SET_PLATFORMS replaces it at runtime (boards that import geometry, e.g. stitched open worlds) and RESTART deliberately does NOT reseed it, so injected geometry survives respawns.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Running
overridableConfigKeys.description: When true the 33ms physics tick integrates and collides; toggle to freeze the body

overridableConfigKeys.label: Curve Skating
overridableConfigKeys.description: When true, a grounded body within skateSnap of the skateCurve surface rides the curve: y snaps to the interpolated surface and tangential gravity (g·slope/(1+slope²)) accelerates vx, so the body slides downhill along the graph and launches off its ends; JUMP kicks free. Engages when grounded, when landing on a tile, or when a falling (not rising) body passes within skateSnap above the surface.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Skate Curve
overridableConfigKeys.description: Surface samples (x strictly increasing) the body skates when skate is on; y is the surface height for the body's MIN corner, linearly interpolated between bracketing samples — mirror the render-side curve so what you see is what you ride. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live curve is entity.skateCurve — SET_SKATE_CURVE replaces it at runtime (stitched mega-curves) and RESTART does not reseed it.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Skate Max Gap
overridableConfigKeys.description: Largest x-gap between consecutive skateCurve samples that still counts as surface. 0 = unlimited (sparse two-sample lines skate fine). Dense resampled curves with real gaps between segments (stitched worlds) MUST set this — otherwise the sampler invents a skatable chord across every gap (an invisible line above the bridge/terrain that the body snaps to and glides along).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Skate Snap
overridableConfigKeys.description: Max vertical gap (world units) between the body's min corner and the curve surface for skating to engage or stay engaged; larger values grab earlier on landing, smaller values release sooner on bumps

overridableConfigKeys.label: Spawn Body
overridableConfigKeys.description: Initial body rect (min-corner x/y plus width/height) seeded on INIT/RESTART; width/height also define the collision box

overridableConfigKeys.label: Right Wall
overridableConfigKeys.description: Largest x the body's min corner may hold (world bounds, not level geometry)

overridableConfigKeys.label: Left Wall
overridableConfigKeys.description: Smallest x the body's min corner may hold (world bounds, not level geometry)

overridableConfigKeys.label: Features
overridableConfigKeys.description: One row per collectible: id, center (x, y in world units), board-defined kind (star, boost, …), display glyph and message floated on pickup. collected is stamped at runtime. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.pickups — SET_FEATURES replaces it at runtime (boards that import collectibles), and RESTART re-arms the live set rather than re-reading config, so injected features survive respawns.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Reach X
overridableConfigKeys.description: Horizontal tolerance (world units) around a feature's center when testing player contact.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Reach Y
overridableConfigKeys.description: Vertical tolerance (world units) around a feature's center when testing player contact; generous values catch fly-through pickups.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Running
overridableConfigKeys.description: When true, BODY_MOVED collects touched features; toggle to freeze the set as-is.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Running
overridableConfigKeys.description: When true, PROGRESS signals resolve win/lose; toggle to freeze

overridableConfigKeys.label: Choice Gates
overridableConfigKeys.description: One row per gate: id, gate center (x, y — y is the option-platform surface the judge tests against), the hint floated on a wrong answer, and the options: id, dx offset from the gate center, the label drawn above the platform, and correct. solved/chosen are stamped at runtime. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.choices — SET_GATES replaces it at runtime (boards that import gates), and RESTART re-arms the live set rather than re-reading config, so injected gates survive respawns.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Reach X
overridableConfigKeys.description: Horizontal tolerance (world units) around an option platform's center when testing a landing (approximates the body's half-width plus a step).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Reach Y
overridableConfigKeys.description: Vertical tolerance (world units) around the gate's option plane when testing a landing (covers small hops onto the platform surface).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Running
overridableConfigKeys.description: When true, BODY_MOVED judges option landings; toggle to freeze every gate as-is.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Decay Rate
overridableConfigKeys.description: Ttl units removed from every fx entry each tick; higher fades particles faster.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Initial Fx
overridableConfigKeys.description: Seed particles rendered before the first BURST; usually empty.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Running
overridableConfigKeys.description: When true the decay tick runs; toggle to freeze effects.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Running
overridableConfigKeys.description: When false all narrative events are ignored.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Styles
overridableConfigKeys.description: Map of narrative style to color, size, ttl, and effect. Override per game theme.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Auto Show
overridableConfigKeys.description: When true the tutorial opens on INIT for this run; when false it stays hidden until SHOW.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Preview trait
overridableConfigKeys.description: Trait rendered in the media position of the modal — the live, demo-driven preview of the mechanic (a bare game canvas, no shell chrome). '@trait.TutorialEmptyPreview' leaves the slot blank. Override with '@trait.<TraitName>' to show a board's live frame.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Steps
overridableConfigKeys.description: One row per tutorial page: title, one line of body copy, and an optional demoId that plays a scripted live demo (std-tutorial-autodemo) for the mechanic being taught.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Agency trait
overridableConfigKeys.description: Trait that provides player verbs and immediate response. Usually a rebinding of std-platformer-body, std-motion-body, or std-hero-nav.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Background Asset
overridableConfigKeys.description: Game-shell background panel sprite (theme chrome).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Challenge trait
overridableConfigKeys.description: Trait that provides the obstacle, decision, or opposition. Usually a rebinding of std-choice-gate, std-gate-lock, std-patrol-hazard, std-velocity-gate, std-loop-lock, or std-pad-lock.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Direction Assets
overridableConfigKeys.description: D-pad direction icon sprites.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Feedback trait
overridableConfigKeys.description: Trait that provides visual, audio, or narrative feedback. Usually a rebinding of std-fx-particles, std-fx-narrative, std-tutorial-overlay, std-audio-cue, or std-zone-card.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Goal trait
overridableConfigKeys.description: Trait that resolves the win condition. Usually a rebinding of std-objective-flow or std-objective-reach.

overridableConfigKeys.label: HUD Background Asset
overridableConfigKeys.description: HUD panel background sprite (theme chrome).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Reward trait
overridableConfigKeys.description: Trait that provides collectibles or scoring. Usually a rebinding of std-pickup, std-score, std-xp, or std-gold.
